scope: AMP H5 terminal-conditioned context EB development experiment; independently implemented, not official PBCT replication
historical_ar_caveat: Fixed historical terminal-from-BOS AR; earlier development exposure. Not assigned fresh CV or claimed train-only-selected. Fresh ar_cv uses same 62501-parameter architecture and receives equal nine candidate selection opportunities.

grouping.method: Train-only connected components of normalized Levenshtein similarity >=0.70 across both terminal states, no inherited component_id used
grouping.packing: Deterministic greedy normalized terminal squared-load minimization, size-first hash tie order
guards: each heldout fold >=5 rows each terminal
every fold-training portion has both terminals
grouping.interpretation: Operational near-duplicate control, not biological homology proof

selection.primary: Mean full-sequence NLL within each terminal, then equal terminal mean over all out-of-fold rows
selection.tie: Exact numeric score then preregistered grid index
selection.shared_tree: Fit independently on fold-training rows only per depth; same tree reused for pooled/separate/partial emissions
selection.ngram: Maximum context lengths 1/2/3 with terminal-specific longest-seen suffix backoff and add-alpha smoothing; terminology context length, not total n-gram order

training.shuffle: Independent torch CPU generator seed222; partial final batch retained; reshuffle at epoch end
training.trajectory_reuse: Per fold/lr one 1000-step trajectory scored at250/500/1000; no development monitoring

metrics_policy.primary: Frozen predictive full sequence conditional NLL: every residue from BOS and first EOS iff length<48, no extra EOS at cap48; terminal means and equal terminal mean
metrics_policy.secondary: Token NLL, AA/EOS NLL; all unfiltered generation validity, EOS/cap, lengths, frozen MMD, AA/dipeptide JS, exact copy, nearest identity, entropy
metrics_policy.generation: Temperature1; six methods x2terminals x32requests=384; no oracle length, no rejection, no replenishment; identical integer seeds across methods but torch/Python RNG streams differ
metrics_policy.development: One post-freeze scoring pass; reused development set from prior work, not a new holdout. Independent checks use saved outputs.

success_rule: Partial must strictly improve balanced sequence NLL over every primary control in grouped CV and over all controls including historical AR on dev, with neither terminal worse (tolerance1e-9). Generation empty, <5, cap48, exact-copy counts cannot exceed pooled, separate, fresh AR or historical AR in either terminal. All distribution metrics reported without selective claims. Any failure NOT_SUPPORTED; no retune.
failure_rule: Invalid grouping, hashes, nonfinite scores/gradients, sample execution or budget failure => BLOCKED with partial outputs retained; no retry or relaxed rule.
audit: Save all per-fold per-config model states, heldout/training molecule membership, token NLL traces, every CV score and all final generation strings; independent postrun recomputation has no new fitting/sampling.
